params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $cmd=Get-Command agentctl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($cmd){Write-Output ('AGENTCTL='+$cmd.Source); & agentctl --help}else{Write-Output 'AGENTCTL_NOT_FOUND'; Get-ChildItem -Path $HOME -Filter agentctl* -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 20 FullName | ConvertTo-Json -Compress}
